title: Action de Galois sur Teichmüller : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting (from pp. 54-57). Σ* is the Riemann sphere minus a 3-element set J (abstractly {0,1,∞}). Σ_0* is the standard model P^1 − {0,1,∞}. P_+ and P_- (written P_ε, ε = ±) are the two 'centres' of the triangle J, i.e. the images of e^{±iπ/3}. These are the two points fixed by the order-3 rotations. Π_ε = π_1(Σ*, P_ε) and Π_{0,3} = π_1(Σ_0*, P_+).

A 'repère' r = (i, ω, ϖ) consists of three pieces of data: a point i ∈ J; an orientation or cyclic order ω, giving the ordering of the other two points; and the side ϖ (ε). Such frames correspond to conformal isomorphisms u_r : (Σ_0*, P_+) → (Σ*, P_ε) sending the standard frame {∞, 0, 1} to r. On the previous page Grothendieck defined ψ_r = π_1(u_r) : Π_{0,3} → Π_ε by transport of structure. He counted six choices of ψ_r for fixed ε.

On this page he records the equivariance (naturality) of this construction. The full symmetry group of (Σ*, J) is generated by conformal and anticonformal automorphisms: S_J × Z/2, with τ the complex conjugation.
- 3-cycles fix both P_±.
- Transpositions and τ each exchange P_+ and P_-.
- Hence the stabilizer of P_ε is Γ_{P_ε} = {(g, τ^α) : α = 0 if sgn g = 1, α = 1 if sgn g = −1}. This is a copy of S_3, which Grothendieck calls S̃_J. It is the same subgroup for both ε.

For g ∈ S̃_J, transport of structure gives the commutative triangle (37): ψ_{g(r)} = π_1(g) ∘ ψ_r, where π_1(g) : Π_ε → Π_ε. Anticonformal elements act on π_1 as orientation-reversing automorphisms. Since S̃_J acts simply transitively on the frames attached to a fixed ε, this determines all ψ_r from one of them.

Grothendieck then notes that this is not yet satisfactory. One should express the change of frame as a formula for automorphisms acting on the source Π_{0,3}, i.e. right composition. That is done on the next page (38)-(41): ψ_{r g_0} = ψ_r ∘ π_1(g_0, P_+). It is made explicit for the rotation ρ and the reflection σ̃_∞.

Purpose. The aim is to set up a symmetric base point (the centre of the triangle, defined over Q(√−3)) for the fundamental groupoid of P^1 − {0,1,∞}. With it the S_3 ⋊ (complex conjugation) symmetries act by explicit automorphisms of the profinite group. This is needed to write the S_3-symmetry (2- and 3-cycle) compatibilities of the Galois/Teichmüller action. It belongs to the 1978+ preparatory work for the Teichmüller tower and Grothendieck–Teichmüller.
errors: Notational sloppiness. 'Γ = S_J' must mean the full group of conformal and anticonformal automorphisms, S_J × Z/2. The displayed subgroup Γ_{P_ε} lies in S_J × Z/2, not in S_J.
The target is written Π_ϖ in the first display but Π_ε in the diagram. This is an inconsistency in indices, not a mathematical error.
The stabilizer Γ_{P_ε} as described does not actually depend on ε (it is the same subgroup for P_+ and P_-). This is correct, but the notation suggests otherwise.
The formula ψ_{g(r)} = π_1(g)∘ψ_r is left-composition on the target. Grothendieck himself flags that the more useful form is right action on Π_{0,3}, which he supplies next page. No real gap.

ideas.what: Use of the centre of the triangle (fixed point e^{iπ/3} of the 3-fold symmetry) as an S_3-symmetric base point for π_1(P^1−{0,1,∞}), with frames forming a torsor under a twisted S_3 ⊂ S_3 × ⟨complex conjugation⟩
ideas.modern_name: symmetric base point / S_3-equivariance of π_1(M_{0,4}); dihedral-type symmetry in GT
ideas.usually_credited_to: Drinfeld (1990) and Ihara for the S_3-type relations in GT; symmetric base points discussed by Ihara, Nakamura, Lochak–Schneps in the 1990s
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme (1984) mentions the S_3 symmetry and base points informally; no explicit formula there

ideas.what: Stabilizer of P_ε in Aut^{±}(P^1,{0,1,∞}) = {(g,τ^{α}) : α = parity of g}, acting simply transitively on frames
ideas.modern_name: twisted S_3 (graph of the sign character) inside S_3 × Gal(C/R)

ideas.what: Transport-of-structure equivariance ψ_{g(r)} = π_1(g)∘ψ_r and programme to convert it into explicit right action on Π_{0,3}
ideas.modern_name: naturality of comparison isomorphisms between fundamental groups at different base points / torsor of frames

missed.claim: Grothendieck systematically includes complex conjugation (anticonformal maps) alongside S_3 when fixing base points at the triangle centres. This anticipates the treatment of Gal(Q(√−3)/Q) and the real structure in the S_3-symmetry of the GT action with the non-rational symmetric base point. It is a documentation-level detail of his early (≥1978) approach rather than a new result.
missed.quote: Γ_{P_ε} = {(g,τ^α) ∈ S_J × Z/2Z | α = 0 si sg g = 1, α = 1 si sg g = −1}
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Historical: shows Grothendieck's early, concrete set-up of S_3 ⋊ conjugation symmetries for the Galois action on π_1 of the thrice-punctured sphere. This predates Drinfeld/Ihara's GT relations.

deep.surprise_reason: A careful but routine bookkeeping page: stabilizers, a frame torsor and a transport-of-structure diagram. It is historically interesting as part of Grothendieck's pre-Esquisse setup of symmetric base points, but there is no new mathematics beyond what is standard in the GT literature.
transcription_corrections: 'Γ = S_J' should be read as Γ = full (anti)conformal group S_J × Z/2Z. The '||' under S̃_J indicates S̃_J = Γ_{P_ε}.

Line after the diagram: 'ψ_{g(r)} = π_1(g)∘ψ_r, vu que S̃_J est simplement transitif sur l'ensemble des repères r correspondant à un ε fixé'. The stray 'ψ·' is a crossed-out fragment, and 'ou que' should read 'vu que'.
'on devrait exprimer le passage par une formule des transformations dans Π_{0,3}' — 'dans' is underlined in the original.
Diagram top arrow label is ψ_r = ψ^ε_{ϖ,i} (left) and ψ_{g(r)} = ψ^{g(ε)}_{g(ϖ),g(i)} (right). The horizontal arrow goes from Π_ε (bold E, overwritten) to Π_ε.
First display target likely Π_ε rather than Π_ϖ; the second line reads 'r ∈ Rep(J, ϖ) ≃ Isom((Σ_0*,P_+),(Σ*,P_+))'.
Struck-out phrase near 'g ∈ S̃_J' appears to be '[-dans quelque-] [-...-]' replaced by '∀ éléments'.
Last lines: 'Notons que le domaine des repères ř dépend ... (aucun intérêt?)' remains uncertain.
